items.title: Sadie Goodson Interview, 1984-12-12
items.q: If you come to us talking, Paul.

ctx.x: Sure it was good. I was glad to get that. I was sure too.

Man I thought I'd need some money then. You ready to hear another record? If you come to us talking, Paul. Okay? Ready. Okay, roll them Lizelle. Just that one number, Panama. Stomp off. Let's go. I don't hear you. I don't hear you. She didn't stop off.
She didn't turn the speaker off. Is it going? Not unless you turn the speakers off.
